name: query_opentargets
description: Get drug targets and disease associations from Open Targets platform for a gene
usage: from app.tools.biomni.database_connectors import query_opentargets; result = query_opentargets('ENSG00000141510', top_k=10)

parameters.gene_id: str — Ensembl gene ID (e.g. 'ENSG00000141510') or gene symbol
parameters.top_k: int — number of top disease and drug associations to return (default 10)

returns: dict with keys: gene_id, diseases (list of {disease, score, datatypes}), drugs (list of {drug, mechanism, phase}), source
